description: This file defines the core connection management for the Playwright library, including the Connection class, Root class, and related methods for handling remote object communication, message dispatching, and object creation within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root object in the Playwright connection, responsible for initializing the Playwright instance.

classes.name: DummyChannelOwner
classes.description: A placeholder class extending ChannelOwner, used for unsupported or dummy channels.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Manages the connection to the Playwright server, handles message dispatching, object management, and communication protocols.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Playwright instance through the root object.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Checks if the connection is remote.

methods.name: useRawBuffers
methods.description: Enables raw buffer mode for the connection.

methods.name: rawBuffers
methods.description: Returns whether raw buffer mode is enabled.

methods.name: localUtils
methods.description: Returns the local utilities associated with the connection.

methods.name: setIsTracing
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing for the connection.

methods.name: sendMessageToServer
methods.description: Sends a message to the server, handling object references and message metadata.

methods.name: _validatorFromWireContext
methods.description: Creates a validator context for wire protocol validation.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages, handling responses, events, and object lifecycle commands.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection, rejecting pending callbacks and emitting a close event.

methods.name: _tChannelImplFromWire
methods.description: Resolves channel implementations from wire protocol data.

methods.name: _createRemoteObject
methods.description: Creates remote object instances based on type and initializer data.
